result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major data display bug showing €NaN delivery and a minor layout overflow on a restaurant name.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers shows '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid delivery fee, indicating a failed number format or missing price.
issues.suggestion: Handle null/invalid delivery fees with a fallback (e.g. 'Free' or a real amount) and never render NaN.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is cut off at the right edge of its card.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines or truncate with an ellipsis so the name stays fully readable.
